blind.summary: Priya talks 90s, then blind-transfers to queue 4001; Marcus finishes the call.

2001.notes: Tom Becker (Lakeside Dental) needs two new front desk users and a queue change. Verified account 619-555-0144. Transferred to provisioning.

2002.notes: Added Maria Delgado (x106) and James Whitfield (x107) with voicemail to email. Reception queue changed to round robin, 15s timeout. Flagged after-hours greeting for re-recording. Ticket 47215.

attended.summary: Priya holds the caller, consults Marcus, then transfers with Replaces.

2001.notes: Main number going to voicemail since this morning. Answering rules edited at 6 AM. Briefed Marcus and transferred.

2002.notes: After-hours schedule was left active all day. Restored business hours and confirmed with a test call. Customer to check who edited the portal.

park.summary: Priya parks the caller on 700; Marcus picks up from park.

2001.notes: Invoice about $200 higher than usual. Parked on 700 for billing.

2002.notes: 10 numbers ordered instead of 2. Removed the 8 extra numbers and credited their charges. Credit shows on next invoice.

3way.summary: Priya moves the caller onto bridge 800; Priya and Marcus join for a 3-way call.

2001.notes: Fax line port rejected twice. Set up a 3-way call with Marcus on the porting team.

2002.notes: Account number on the port form had an extra digit (44121 vs 4412). Corrected and resubmitted; new port date next Thursday.

blind2.summary: Two blind transfers: Priya -> Marcus -> Dana.

2001.notes: Phones at the new Fifth Street office show no service. Transferred to provisioning.

2002.notes: Phones provisioned correctly but never checked in. Likely the new site's firewall. Transferred to network engineering.

2003.notes: Sonic Gate 400 router blocks SIP by default. Customer turned off SIP helper; phones registered. Noted on the account.

hold.summary: No transfer: Priya puts the caller on hold twice for 20-30s.

2001.notes: Call recordings missing from the portal since Friday. A permissions update removed recording access from the practice director role. Restored it; customer confirmed.

long.summary: About 14 minutes: Priya holds twice and transfers to Marcus, who holds twice.

2001.notes: Office move to Ridge Ave on the 28th, tech on site 8 AM, internet live the 26th. Voicemail to email blocked by the customer's spam filter: allow voicemail@meridianvoice.com. Fax port unaffected. Transferred to provisioning.

2002.notes: Summer hours from June 1 (Sat 9-1); removed the conflicting holiday schedule. Added Emma Price (x115) and Daniel Ruiz (x116). Turned on recording for the Sales group. Customer to re-record the main greeting.

upset.summary: Bad sentiment: an angry repeat caller; Priya holds once, can't fix the dropped calls or give a credit, and he hangs up unhappy.

2001.notes: Third call about dropped calls mid-conversation. No errors in our call logs; customer says internet is fine. Escalated to network team (callback in 1-2 business days). Customer requested a service credit - noted, not approved. Customer very frustrated, threatened to switch providers if not fixed by Friday.
